Class C2paTileSink

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.sink.AbstractTileSink
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.sink.AbstractDelegatingTileSink
de.christianmahnke.jc2pa.C2paTileSink
All Implemented Interfaces:
TileSink, AutoCloseable
@AutoService(TileSink.class) public class C2paTileSink extends AbstractDelegatingTileSink implements AutoCloseable
A TileSink decorator that signs every tile with a C2PA manifest before it is written.

The tile is first rendered by a delegate sink (by default the default sink), the resulting bytes are signed through the TileSigner service, and the signed bytes are written to the real output stream.

The per-tile manifest contains the tile's region in source-image coordinates (provided by the Tiler via the iiif.region.* metadata entries) as a custom org.projektemacher.iiif.region assertion.

Options (via --sink-opt):

  • delegate — name of the delegate sink (default: default).
  • format — tile format (default: jpg; handled by the base class).
  • runtime — WASM engine selection: auto (default), chicory, or graalvm.
  • cert / key — paths to PEM certificate chain and private key files. When both are set, tiles are signed with real key material (alg selects the algorithm, default es256; optional tsa timestamp authority URL).
  • cert-name — common name for the ephemeral certificate used when no cert/key is given (default: fliiifenleger). Ephemeral signatures are for testing only.
  • claim-generator — claim generator string written into the manifest.
  • trust-anchor — absolute URI advertised as trustAnchor in the https://christianmahnke.de/iiif/c2pa/ service entry of a V3 info.json. Requires --iiif-version V3; fails with Image API 2 since V2 offers no place for namespaced options.
  • threads — parallel signing lanes (default: one per available processor capped at 4; 1 selects serial execution). Each lane pairs one interpreter instance with its own thread; -Dwasm.lanes=N sets the default when unset.

info.json: always advertises https://christianmahnke.de/iiif/c2pa/ (V3 service + extraFeatures, V2 supports entry).

Threading: the Tiler generates tiles concurrently; all WASM access is routed through the TileSigner's lane pool (one lane per available processor capped at 4 by default, serial with threads=1).

Note: c2pa-rs keeps process-global state — do not run multiple C2PA sinks (or other C2paWasm users) in the same JVM.

    • getInfoJsonExtension

      public TileSink.InfoExtension getInfoJsonExtension(ImageInfo.IIIFVersion version)
      Advertises C2PA support in info.json via C2PA_PROFILE_URI.
      • V3: prepends C2PA_CONTEXT_URI to @context, adds a service entry and an extraFeatures entry. When trust-anchor is set, it is written as the namespaced trustAnchor property of that service entry.
      • V2: adds the profile URI to the embedded profile supports list. A trust-anchor cannot be expressed (fixed @context, no place for namespaced properties) and fails with IllegalArgumentException.
      Specified by:
      getInfoJsonExtension in interface TileSink
